description:
A shareable OpenSearch synonym_graph (or legacy synonym) token filter. SynonymSets belong to an Organization; the qualified name {organizationName}-{name} is what a SearchConfiguration references in its synonymSets list to bring this filter into the index. SynonymSets are injected into analyzers at the synapse_synonyms placeholder position in indexFilterOrder / searchFilterOrder — see TextAnalyzerSettings for the rule.

Example — OpenSearch native synonym syntax: a, b, c for equivalent (bidirectional) and a, b => c, d for explicit (directional) expansion:

{
  "organizationName": "biomed",
  "name": "medical_terms",
  "definition": "{\"type\":\"synonym_graph\",\"synonyms\":[\"tumor, neoplasm, cancer\",\"AD => Alzheimer's disease\"]}"
}

Tuning suggestions:

  • Multi-word synonyms — prefer synonym_graph (it handles phrases correctly):
    "definition": "{\"type\":\"synonym_graph\",\"synonyms\":[\"new york city, NYC, nyc\"]}"
  • Disable bidirectional expansion (only the LHS is a synonym source): set "expand":false in the definition.
  • Tolerate malformed rule lines without failing the whole filter: set "lenient":true in the definition.

Cannot be deleted while any persisted resource references it. See the OpenSearch synonym_graph filter docs for the full parameter list (synonyms, format, expand, lenient, etc.).

id.description: The unique ID of this synonym set.

organizationName.description: The Organization that owns this resource. Immutable after creation.

name.description: Resource name (letters, digits, underscores, must start with a letter). Combined with organizationName to form the qualified name '{organizationName}-{name}'. Immutable after creation.

definition.description:
Required. The full OpenSearch token filter definition as a JSON object string. Must include a type of synonym or synonym_graph (synonym_graph is recommended — see the OpenSearch docs for why). All other parameters (expand, lenient, format, updateable, etc.) are passthrough — supply them as OpenSearch documents them.

AOSS note: file-based parameters like synonyms_path are rejected at create/update time (AOSS Serverless does not support file uploads). Supply the synonym list inline via the synonyms array using OpenSearch's native syntax: a, b, c for equivalent, a, b => c, d for explicit.

etag.description: Synapse Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) value. Send the etag from a GET back on update; a mismatch returns 409.

createdBy.description: ID of the user that created this resource.

modifiedOn.description: When this resource was last modified.

modifiedBy.description: ID of the user that last modified this resource.
